title: Contributing to apa7
text: Fork package clone onto computer. haven’t done , recommend using usethis::create_from_github("wjschne/apa7", fork = TRUE). Install development dependencies devtools::install_dev_deps(), make sure package passes R CMD check running devtools::check(). R CMD check doesn’t pass cleanly, ’s good idea ask help continuing. Create Git branch pull request (PR). recommend using usethis::pr_init("brief-description--change"). Make changes, commit git, create PR running usethis::pr_push(), following prompts browser. title PR briefly describe change. body PR contain Fixes #issue-number. user-facing changes, add bullet top NEWS.md (.e. just first header). Follow style described https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html.

title: apa7 0.2.0 2026-10-18
text: New apa_anova() makes APA-style ANOVA source tables aov lm models (Type 1 sums squares, Types 2 3 via car::Anova()), repeated-measures aov models Error() strata, afex models, tables stats::anova() car::Anova(). Effect sizes (partial, non-partial, generalized η2, ω2, ε2) two-sided confidence intervals come effectsize. New apa_note() writes text table note. apa_parameters() tables regression models (including lists models lme4 models), says robust standard errors used, mixed-model degrees freedom approximated, ordinal thresholds tested, defines standardized coefficient, exponentiated coefficient (e.g., ), confidence interval, R2 change columns. apa_loadings() apa_factor_cor() tables, gives extraction method rotation, says oblique loadings pattern coefficients, explains omitted bolded loadings h2, u2, Complexity columns. apa_anova() tables, gives type sums squares, effects sphericity-corrected degrees freedom (afex models), effect size MSE stand , stars bold values mean. apaquarto, use #| apa-note: !expr apa7::apa_note(tbl). Without apaquarto, apa_flextable(note = TRUE) places note table. apa_parameters() now returns ANOVA table aov, repeated-measures aov, afex models. , aov models treated lm models gave coefficients table. apa_loadings() reworked: now returns apa7_tbl, renders flextable Quarto R Markdown. supports psych::principal() well psych::fa(), output parameters::factor_analysis() parameters::principal_components() (including unrotated components stats::prcomp()). New bold_max argument bolds largest loading row. New factor_names argument relabels factors. New variance argument adds rows sum squared loadings proportion cumulative proportion variance explained, rule . New communality, digits, format_variable_names arguments. apa_flextable() longer reformats item text Variable column. Small loadings now blank strings rather NA. unused column_formats argument removed. New apa_factor_cor() makes table factor correlations obliquely rotated psych::fa(), psych::principal(), parameters::factor_analysis() solutions. column_format() gains abbreviation slot says header stands (e.g., "standardized coefficient" β). apa_note() defines every abbreviated header table slots, table type, setting slot column_formats adds changes definition. default column formats define common abbreviations (e.g., CI, AIC, BIC, RMSEA, effect sizes, R2 variants), column_formats() gains get_abbreviations getter. New column formats h2, u2, Complexity set headers apa_loadings() columns. apa_flextable() gains note argument: TRUE adds note apa_note() table, character string adds custom note. note affect column widths. apa_flextable() leaves alone columns named "no_format_columns" attribute data, draws rule row named "rule_above" attribute. Partial η2 columns (Eta2_partial) now headed η2p. New column formats: Sum_Squares, Mean_Square, Eta2_generalized, Omega2, Omega2_partial, Epsilon2, Epsilon2_partial. make_apaquarto() install_apaquarto() now list missing packages separately ask short “Install now?” question, prompt readable console (e.g., R macOS). New ask argument installs missing packages without asking FALSE. installation declined, function stops prints install.packages() command run.
